subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: Should this issue remain open as the concrete P0 Telegram satellite under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101863, or should maintainers designate a narrower canonical issue for Telegram exact-send reconciliation plus poisoned-session recovery?
rationale: The remaining behavior spans run lifecycle, outbound delivery, Telegram adapter capability, restart replay semantics, and non-technical recovery UX; source review can show the gaps but cannot choose the permanent recovery contract.

options.title: Keep as lifecycle satellite
options.body: Keep this issue open as concrete production evidence while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101863 owns the broader lifecycle design and smaller PRs land individual fixes.

options.title: Split Telegram recovery
options.body: Create or designate a narrower canonical issue for Telegram unknown-send reconciliation, pending-final-delivery restart replay, and poisoned-session recovery, then link this issue as source evidence.

options.title: Close only after full proof
options.body: Close this issue only after current main or a shipped release proves the reported path no longer duplicates Telegram sends or requires manual session recovery.

recommendation.title: Keep as lifecycle satellite
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as concrete production evidence while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101863 owns the broader lifecycle design and smaller PRs land individual fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee and the strongest current routing signal for deciding how this P0 Telegram/session recovery report should be tracked.
